t2.thesis: META's entry-to-exit-open move is essentially the earnings gap, with a large implied move (~7.4%) and no clear directional edge, so I stay near the base rate with a small discount for a poor recent reaction history and negative estimate revisions.
reasons: Base rate for AMC and software_internet is about 54%, so the prior is modestly positive.
The last 4 prints include 3 declines, and the last 2 gaps were large down moves (-11% and -7%), though one is a mechanical artifact of small samples.
EPS estimates have been cut sharply (-22% over 90 days), which lowers the bar, but capex and legal-exposure worries persist.
The stock is about 11% below its 52-week high and fell 9.5% in the last 5 days, which sets up a possible relief bounce, and the Sept rally narrative is positive.
Implied move of about 7.4% is high but symmetric; call and put IVs are roughly balanced, so options show no directional lean.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guidance versus capex and expense outlook: whether the revenue acceleration justifies the 2027 spending trajectory and whether more legal charges appear.

prior.from: I3 overall validation buy-everything hit rate 0.542; AMC session 0.538; software_internet cluster 0.541
